properties.event_narrative: Water in parking lot and recreation area near the Heart of the Valley Trail.
Boston Post Road bridge reported inaccessible due to flood waters from an ice jam release.
An ice jam release has caused ice to flush out of the Great Chazy River into the Mooers Camp and cause minor flooding in the area.
0.1 inches of flat ice measured through 6 PM.
